# Peacemakers AI

> Peacemakers AI is an AI automation consulting firm based in Asheville, North Carolina. We help service-based businesses nationwide reduce manual work, improve follow-up, and decide where process, current tools, automation, or AI actually helps. Work is remote. We do not assume you need new software.

## How to start

- [Book a 15-minute intro](https://calendly.com/james-peacemakersai): A short fit call for process and next steps — not a free consulting session.
- [Free AI Opportunity Scorecard](https://www.peacemakersai.com/scorecard): A quick readiness check before buying more tools.
- [AI Opportunity Blueprint](https://www.peacemakersai.com/blueprint): Paid $3,500 diagnostic. Written recommendations, current-tool fit, and prioritized next steps. Implementation is a separate decision.
